description: Helper functions for data formatting, calculations, and transformations used in a dashboard frontend.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a number as currency string in USD or specified currency.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number with suffixes (K, M, B) based on magnitude.

methods.name: formatPercentage
methods.description: Converts a decimal to a percentage string with specified decimals.

methods.name: calculateCTR
methods.description: Calculates click-through rate as a percentage.

methods.name: calculateConversionRate
methods.description: Calculates conversion rate as a percentage.

methods.name: getDateRange
methods.description: Returns start and end dates for a given number of days.

methods.name: generateDateSeries
methods.description: Generates an array of date strings between start and end dates.

methods.name: aggregateMetrics
methods.description: Aggregates data by a specified field and computes derived metrics.

methods.name: getPerformanceStatus
methods.description: Determines performance status based on thresholds.

methods.name: getMetricTrend
methods.description: Determines trend direction between current and previous values.

methods.name: calculateGrowthRate
methods.description: Calculates percentage growth rate between two values.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Sorts data array by specified field and direction.

methods.name: filterData
methods.description: Filters data array based on provided filter criteria.
